exposure: Prolonged rupture of membranes (yes vs. no)
cohort: 60 neonates born with gestational age < 34 weeks
finding: Prolonged rupture of membranes was significantly negatively associated with cord serum CC16, after adjusting for gestational age, mode of conception, and delivery mode, and CC16 was significantly inversely associated with BPD, after adjusting for gestational age and birth weight.
mod_finding: While the study adjusted for mode of delivery, there were no specific findings related to mode of delivery and its impact on outcomes.
